h1: Document review workflow with summaries and flags
overview: Drop a document into a folder or email inbox and receive a short summary, the key dates and amounts, and a list of items that need a human look. We set the workflow up around the document types you handle most, such as supplier contracts, invoices, applications or reports. You decide what counts as a flag, and the summary always links back to the page it came from.

faq: Is it safe to upload private documents?
We work inside your own accounts and choose tools whose data terms suit your needs. We tell you plainly where files are processed before we start, and we never keep copies after delivery.
Can it give legal or financial advice?
No. It summarizes and flags what you ask for, and a person makes the decision. It is a reading assistant, not a replacement for your lawyer or accountant.
What about scanned or handwritten pages?
Clean scans usually work. Poor scans or handwriting can produce mistakes, so we test on your samples first and tell you honestly how well it reads them.
Does it need to know my industry?
Not in advance. You give us examples and a short list of what matters, and we shape the instructions around them. The more sample files you share, the better the first version.
